system.description:
This active nanotechnology bonds with the morph’s neural structures, creating a series of specialized cognitive subprocessors that enhance the user’s intelligence. It provides users with a +5 modifier to COG. However, enhancing intelligence is a difficult process and this enhancement is based on techniques used on existing morphs. It has no effect if used on a morph that has a COG modifier of +10 or more. This augmentation can be used on biomorphs, pods, and synthmorphs.

Source: Eclipse Phase Rimward, p. 189.
